mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_behavior_log (behavior_id, tenant_id, actor_id, actor_type, member_id, store_id, schedule_id, reservation_id, checkin_id, action, source, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{actorType}, #{memberId}, #{storeId}, #{scheduleId}, #{reservationId}, #{checkinId}, #{action}, #{source}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, COALESCE(m.real_name,m.nickname) AS memberName, st.store_name AS storeName, CASE WHEN b.actor_type = 'member' THEN COALESCE(am.real_name,am.nickname) ELSE u.nick_name END AS actorName FROM fit_behavior_log b LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id=b.member_id AND m.tenant_id=b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN fit_member am ON am.member_id=b.actor_id AND am.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND b.actor_type='member' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=b.actor_id AND u.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND b.actor_type<>'member' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id=b.store_id AND st.tenant_id=b.tenant_id WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.member_id=#{memberId} AND b.action=#{action} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.behavior_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_course_interest (interest_id, tenant_id, member_id, course_id, coach_id, session_id, event_id, active_seconds, source, created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{tenantId},#{memberId},#{courseId},#{coachId},#{sessionId},#{eventId},#{seconds},#{source},NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fit_course_interest WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND event_id=#{eventId}
SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM fit_course_interest WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId}

SELECT co.coach_id FROM fit_coach co WHERE co.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND co.del_flag='0' AND co.hire_status='0' AND (co.coach_id=#{defaultCoachId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fit_member_card mc WHERE mc.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND mc.member_id=#{memberId} AND mc.store_id=#{storeId} AND mc.bind_coach_id=co.coach_id AND mc.del_flag='0' AND mc.card_status IN ('unused','active') AND (mc.expire_time IS NULL OR mc.expire_time>NOW()))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN co.coach_id=#{defaultCoachId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, co.coach_id LIMIT 1

SELECT i.member_id AS memberId, COALESCE(m.real_name,m.nickname) AS memberName, i.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, SUM(i.active_seconds) AS activeSeconds, COUNT(DISTINCT i.session_id) AS viewCount, MAX(i.created_at) AS lastViewedAt FROM fit_course_interest i INNER JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id=i.member_id AND m.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND m.del_flag='0' INNER JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id=i.course_id AND c.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND c.del_flag='0' WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.coach_id=#{coachId} AND i.active_seconds>0 AND i.created_at>DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND (c.default_coach_id=#{coachId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fit_member_card current_card WHERE current_card.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND current_card.member_id=i.member_id AND current_card.bind_coach_id=#{coachId} AND current_card.del_flag='0' AND current_card.card_status IN ('unused','active') AND (current_card.expire_time IS NULL OR current_card.expire_time>NOW()))) AND i.member_id=#{memberId} GROUP BY i.member_id,m.real_name,m.nickname,i.course_id,c.course_name ORDER BY activeSeconds DESC,lastViewedAt DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_checkin_record SET operator_user_id=#{operatorId}, checkin_status=#{status}, consume_times=#{consumeTimes}, consume_amount=#{consumeAmount}, remark=#{remark}, update_time=NOW() WHERE checkin_id=#{checkinId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND del_flag='0' AND operator_user_id IS NULL AND checkin_status<>'reversed'
